decisions.reason: A reference class electrometer is a core dosimetry instrument with long life cycles, and it is featured on the home page in both years.
The oncology risk management software complements the firm's radiation therapy QA portfolio, has kept its own page for two years, and has low marginal costs, so continuing it is the likely choice.
The CT image quality phantom was launched recently, fits the firm's medical imaging QA line, and phantoms of this kind are typically sold for many years.
The mammography phantom serves regulatory QA requirements and was launched only in 2024, so dropping it this soon is unlikely.
The full field mammography phantom adds breadth to the mammography QA offering, and its own dedicated page signals continued commitment.
The imaging QA instruments form a strategic product family that expands the firm's diagnostic imaging business.
